newsitem.title: SWEDEN: VILNIAUS BANK MULLS GLOBAL MARKET TAP.
newsitem.headline: VILNIAUS BANK MULLS GLOBAL MARKET TAP.

text.p: Lithuania's leading bank Vilniaus Bank said on Wednesday that it would probably tap the international capital markets in 1997.

"We will probably have to raise additional capital this year as we plan to participate in the privatisation of the big state banks," Saulius Racevicius of Vilniaus Bank's brokerage house told Reuters at a conference on investment in the Baltic states.
"It could be through GDRs, a eurobond, or a syndicated loan...it is too early to tell yet," he added.
Vilniaus Bank made its debut on the global markets last year when it raised $17.1 million through a GDR issue.
